transcript: If you were raised by a mother whose emotions ruled the house, your nervous system never learned rest, a wrong tone. And the air became dangerous, a spilled drink, and love vanished. A simple no, and your voice was taken from you. So you learned early, be quiet, be careful, do not take up space, do not make mistakes. The child inside you lived as if danger was always near. Years pass, your body grows, but that child is still listening. Now you read a text five times before sending it. When your boss says, can we talk? Your chest tightens. When someone sighs, your mind whispers, what did I do wrong? Not because you are weak, not because you are broken, but because your nervous system is still living in the old house. Understand this, anxiety is not who you are. It is the memory of what kept you safe. Healing does not come from controlling the world or replaying conversations in your mind. Healing begins when you slow down and sit beside the frightened child within you. Let them feel what they were never allowed to feel. Let them breathe without punishment. Let them know the danger has passed. You are not there anymore. You are safe now. If this spoke to something quiet inside you, I wrote an e-book called The Way Back to Stillness. It is not about fixing yourself. It is about remembering safety. The link is in my profile.
